tool.name: UniPEFF
tool.description: Convert a UniProtKB XML protein database to PEFF 1.0 with rich annotations
tool.command:
@QUOTE_FOO@ @EXT_FOO@ #import re
## Preprocessing mkdir in && cp '$in' 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' && mkdir out && #if $ptmlist: mkdir ptmlist && cp '$ptmlist' 'ptmlist/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $ptmlist.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($ptmlist.ext)' && #end if #if $psimod_obo: mkdir psimod_obo && cp '$psimod_obo' 'psimod_obo/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $psimod_obo.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($psimod_obo.ext)' && #end if #if $unimod_obo: mkdir unimod_obo && cp '$unimod_obo' 'unimod_obo/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $unimod_obo.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($unimod_obo.ext)' && #end if
## Main program call
set -o pipefail && @EXECUTABLE@ -write_ctd ./ && python3 '$__tool_directory__/fill_ctd.py' '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$args_json' '$hardcoded_json' && @EXECUTABLE@ -ini @EXECUTABLE@.ctd -in 'in/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $in.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($in.ext)' -out 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("peff")}' #if $ptmlist: -ptmlist 'ptmlist/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $ptmlist.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($ptmlist.ext)' #end if #if $psimod_obo: -psimod_obo 'psimod_obo/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $psimod_obo.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($psimod_obo.ext)' #end if #if $unimod_obo: -unimod_obo 'unimod_obo/${re.sub("[^\w\-_]", "_", $unimod_obo.element_identifier)}.$gxy2omsext($unimod_obo.ext)' #end if
## Postprocessing && mv 'out/output.${gxy2omsext("peff")}' '$out' #if "ctd_out_FLAG" in $OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS && mv '@EXECUTABLE@.ctd' '$ctd_out' #end if

param.label: Input UniProtKB XML file (plain or gzip; gzip is auto-detected)
UniProt ptmlist.txt; defaults to the bundled snapshot
PSI-MOD.obo for canonical modification names; defaults to the bundled OpenMS PSI-MOD.obo
Optional unimod.obo for canonical Unimod names; if absent, names fall back to the UniProt ptmlist IDs
Force a single PEFF prefix for every entry
param.help: (e.g. 'sp'); if empty, sp/tr is derived from the UniProt dataset

param.label: Value for the mandatory '# DbVersion=' PEFF header line
Emit PEFF Option B: assign a global sequential id: prefix to every annotation tuple, referenced by \DisulfideBond
param.help: By default only the \DisulfideBond tuples and the half-cystines they reference get ids: of K bonds, bond k (counting from 0) labels its half-cystines 2k and 2k+1 and is itself labeled 2K+k

param.label: Skip the \Processed annotations (initiator methionine, signal/transit peptide, propeptide, chain)
Skip \ModResPsi / \ModResUnimod / \ModRes and \DisulfideBond; ptmlist is not read
Skip the additional PEFF entries for UniProt isoforms (alternative products whose sequences are reconstructed from splice-variant features)
Enables the test mode (needed for internal use only)

data.name: ctd_out
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: ctd
data.filter: OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS is not None and "ctd_out_FLAG" in OPTIONAL_OUTPUTS

tool.help:
Convert a UniProtKB XML protein database to PEFF 1.0 with rich annotations.
For more information, visit http://www.openms.de/doxygen/release/3.6.0/html/TOPP_UniPEFF.html
